title: Dire wolf carcass found at Dry Gulch Creek and matched by biologist Ben Woodruff
place_text: Dry Gulch Creek, Skinwalker Ranch, Utah

tellings.quote: right there on camera the team happens upon this carcass of this decomposing large wolf-like creature

plain: On camera at Dry Gulch Creek on Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, a research team came upon "this carcass of this decomposing large wolf-like creature," which the biologist Ben Woodruff is said to have matched to a dire wolf, an animal long thought extinct. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, tells Michels this happened in the 2020s, during filming for the TV series The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch.
